svg.title: The whole article on one card
svg.desc: A three by three grid of nine numbered cards, one per article section: parsing and indexing, embedding, retrieval and reranking, serialization, verification, permissions and topology, production, traceability, and knowing the wrong tool. Each card has a one-sentence description, a small boxes-and-arrows sketch, two advantages marked with ticks, one drawback marked with a cross, and a use-when strip.
